description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing currency pair data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including query parameter handling, data transformation, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: FMPCurrencyPairsQueryParams
classes.description: Model for querying available currency pairs from FMP.

classes.name: FMPCurrencyPairsData
classes.description: Data model representing a currency pair from FMP.

classes.name: FMPCurrencyPairsFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class to retrieve and process currency pair data from FMP API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into an FMPCurrencyPairsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw currency pair data from the FMP API endpoint.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into a list of FMPCurrencyPairsData objects, applying filtering based on the query.
